questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Maputo?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Mozambique is Maputo.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Mozambique about 801,590 square kilometres; Spain about 505,990 square kilometres; Republic of the Congo about 342,000 square kilometres; Lesotho about 30,355 square kilometres.

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Mozambique on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Mozambique on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Mozambique?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Mozambique article.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Mozambique?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Mozambique on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography and climate” part of the Mozambique article.

questions.proof: It is bordered by the Indian Ocean to the east, Tanzania to the north, Malawi and Zambia to the northwest, Zimbabwe to the west and Swaziland and South Africa to the southwest.
